channel.title: Sara Woerdehoff, Blog
channel.description: Writing by Sara Woerdehoff, Head of Marketing at WESCO Industries and a nonprofit marketing leader in western Iowa, on nonprofit marketing, small team strategy, AI search visibility, and doing director level work as a department of one.

item.title: Nonprofit Marketing Is Not For Profit Marketing With Less Money
item.description: The difference between nonprofit and for profit marketing is not the budget. It is the goals, the audiences, money that arrives with a rulebook, and a department that fits in one office chair.
